item.title: Version 1.0.25
item.description:
feat: email + 6-digit code sign-in (replaces license-key paste)

Sign in with your email and a 6-digit code we send you — same pattern
Linear, Cursor, Cal.com, and Vercel use.  No more pasting long
activation keys.

Existing license keys still work forever via the same /api/license/redeem
endpoint, so your account from previous versions is unaffected.

Behind the scenes:
  - Refresh tokens stored in Keychain so silent re-auth doesn't bounce
    you back to the email-code prompt every JWT expiry
  - Backend pre-flight health check from 1.0.24 still in place
  - Structured onboarding error recovery from 1.0.23 still in place
